text:
alice: heads-up: we're repeatedly seeing late token arrivals flip ownership claims and that breaks downstream joins in billing. want to propose a clear ingest->billing boundary
ben: yep. current flow lets finalizer mutate records in place which invalidates proofs for already-generated invoices
carla: two high-level fixes: (A) make ingest append-only and emit adjustment events for late changes, or (B) centralize resolution in a reconciler that emits canonical append-only ledger records once "stable"
alice: append-only adjustments keep immediate visibility but push complexity to every consumer. reconciler centralizes truth but introduces a reconciliation window and potential billing lag
ben: hybrid idea: ingest writes ephemeral "candidate_claim" rows and emits a lightweight event with a provenance pointer. reconciler seals and writes canonical ledger events (append-only). billing reads canonical ledger only
carla: agree. define "stable" as: no conflicting candidate within window W OR watermark advanced past event timestamp. reuse existing watermark service where possible
alice: canonical event must include provenance_id and a link to an encrypted snapshot for audits. minimal event shape example:
```
{ "event_id": "sha256(pv||epoch)", "tenant": "acme", "ts": "2026-03-21T15:00:00Z", "ownership": [{"acct":"acct-1","tokens":123}], "provenance_id": "pv_abc123", "snapshot": "s3://redwood-prov/pv_abc123.enc" }
```
ben: reconciler must be idempotent and resumable. deterministic event_id lets consumers de-dupe. also surface reconcile_reason and reconcile_policy in metrics
carla: ops concerns: observability (why sealed), SLA for Dedicated, and an emergency fallback. if reconciler lags beyond threshold T, ingest should emit a coarse-grained safe-attribution event so billing keeps flowing
alice: security: snapshot may contain prompts or PII. default: mask PII, encrypt snapshots, enforce ACLs. store minimal metadata in events to support fast dispute lookup
ben: failure modes: reconciler crash -> ensure durable checkpoints and ability to resume. reconciler should write a commit marker per epoch before publishing ledger event
carla: implementation plan: prototype candidate table + reconciler in staging. metrics: reconcile latency p50/p95, extra storage per 1M events, ratio of adjustments vs sealed-first-try. I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagrams
alice: +1. please include migration plan for historical claims and billing replay constraints. we should avoid full replay where possible
deploy-bot: reconcile-job scheduled: reconcile-1763709999 :white_check_mark:
ben: I'll draft fallback SLA/alerting playbook and a tiny CLI to inspect candidate chains by provenance_id
carla: thanks. once RFC is up we can sync and pick owners for checkpointing and masking rules
alice: awesome. thanks everyone.
